### 1. Total Digital Media Segment Revenue (Fiscal Year 2024)
* **Fiscal 2024 Digital Media segment revenue:** **$15,864 million** (or **$15.86 billion**) 
*(Accession 0000796343-25-000004, Section "Segments", Chunk ID `839ad4e2-d434-562b-b699-c27185c0972b` and Section "Digital Media", Chunk ID `b52db0a2-1d0b-53bc-9889-5dd847e0b67c`)*

---

### 2. Year-over-Year Percentage Growth from Fiscal 2023
* **Fiscal 2023 Digital Media segment revenue:** **$14,216 million** (or **$14.22 billion**)
* **Reported year-over-year growth:** **12%** *(Chunk IDs `839ad4e2-d434-562b-b699-c27185c0972b`, `b52db0a2-1d0b-53bc-9889-5dd847e0b67c`)*

#### Calculation:
$$\text{Growth Rate} = \frac{\$15,864 - \$14,216}{\$14,216} = \frac{\$1,648}{\$14,216} \approx 11.5926\% \approx 12\%$$
